Skill prompt/instructions: Run $supabase-canonicality-audit across Memory Lane as a read-only audit. Start with git status. Map canonical tables, write paths, reads/resolvers, downstream consumers, Supabase queries/RPCs, and schema dependencies. Detect missing migrations, runtime mock or file persistence, fabricated fallbacks, silent persistence failures, seed/runtime drift, and competing sources of truth. Report root causes, exact files and migrations, blockers, and whether each domain is truly Supabase-backed. Do not fix unless separately authorized.

Run $schema-migration-safety-auditor against relevant Supabase migrations and schema-dependent runtime queries. Check destructive changes, backwards compatibility, locking, backfills, constraints, ordering, rollout safety, forward-fix strategy, and schema drift. Cite the migration or runtime file, severity, production impact, and smallest safe correction. Use the skill's required report format. Audit only.

Run $memory-lane-supabase-rls-security-auditor. Map member, role, lead, public-token, and storage access boundaries. Audit RLS enablement and policies in migrations, server actions/routes, public signature and upload flows, service-role usage, token expiry and replay protection, member scoping, role guards, and storage access. Separate confirmed findings, likely risks, and items needing live verification. Return the skill's required report with exact files/tables and smallest safe fixes. Audit only.

Run $shared-resolver-enforcer as a compliance audit across attendance, census, transportation, billing, member command center, care plans, sales, and reporting. Identify each derived business question, its canonical resolver, every competing page/action/report implementation, consumers that should migrate, and duplicate logic that should be removed. Flag remaining canonicality gaps. Do not refactor unless separately authorized.

Classify each major workflow as Must use shared RPC, Should use shared RPC soon, or Fine as service CRUD. Inspect lead conversion, enrollment completion, intake-to-POF, POF signing, MHP/MCC sync, care-plan finalization, member-file persistence, MAR generation, and event coupling. Flag direct writes and duplicated orchestration, assess existing RPC quality, and provide a prioritized migration plan and copy-paste fix prompts.

Run $memory-lane-acid-transaction-auditor as a read-only production audit. Trace high-risk canonical write paths and matching migrations. Evaluate atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability for lead conversion, enrollment, intake-to-POF, POF signing and downstream sync, care-plan finalization, member files, MAR generation, events, and public callbacks. Separate confirmed findings from likely risks; cite exact files, functions, and migrations; assign severity and launch-block status; and recommend the smallest canonical service, RPC, constraint, state-machine, or replay-safety fix.

Run $memory-lane-idempotency-duplicate-auditor as a read-only audit. Map UI/action/route/service/Supabase paths and persisted state transitions for lead creation/conversion, enrollment, public signing/upload links, POF, care plans, intake, MAR, member files, notifications, events, syncs, and billing side effects. Test retry, double-submit, callback replay, duplicate artifact, and repeated-side-effect scenarios. Verify code guards together with migration-backed unique constraints, RPC/locking protection, conflict handling, token expiry/use state, and schema alignment. Label each path Protected or At Risk with evidence, severity, and the smallest hardening fix.

Run $memory-lane-referential-integrity-cascade-auditor from Lead to Enrollment Packet to Member to Intake to POF to MHP to MCC to Care Plans to MAR and clinical activity. Treat migrations and canonical services as truth. Detect orphaned records, missing downstream artifacts, duplicate canonical records, unsupported lifecycle states, missing foreign keys or unique constraints, schema drift, and duplicated UI/action rules. Run $supabase-query-performance-auditor across services, actions, routes, resolvers, lists/dashboards, MAR, MHP, member files, care plans, and audit logs. Enumerate and group Supabase queries. Detect unindexed filters/sorts, table scans, N+1 or looped reads, over-fetching, missing pagination, expensive joins, and duplicated query logic. Cross-check migrations and indexes, then return prioritized findings with exact evidence and the smallest safe performance fix. Audit only.
